settings.question: Will it really stay on?
settings.answer: It holds through contact, sweat and a jersey coming over your head. It is not glued on — a hard direct pull will take it off, which is the point.

settings.question: Is it legal to play in?
settings.answer: Rules vary by league, and most say no visible jewelry during play regardless of how it attaches. Check with your ref or coach. It comes out in a second when you need it to.

settings.question: What size should I get?
settings.answer: All three sizes come in every kit, so you don't have to decide before you order.

settings.question: What is it made of?
settings.answer: Nickel-free surgical steel with a cubic zirconia stone and a neodymium magnet back.

settings.question: Is it a real diamond?
settings.answer: No. It is cubic zirconia, cut and set to read like a diamond at conversation distance, at a price you won't panic about losing.

settings.question: Can I shower or swim in it?
settings.answer: Yes. Dry it after and it will keep its shine longer.

settings.question: How fast does it ship?
settings.answer: Orders go out within one business day, with free shipping on every order.
